abstract: We study constrained completion routes toward larger rational Diophantine tuples. For regular fifth completion of product-one square-product quadruples, an explicit cubic necessary quotient yields rank-zero obstructions and nonvacuous applications. For four-point translation orbits on curves induced by triples, exact diagonal identities give a uniform obstruction when the base product is a 2-adic unit and a rank-zero diagonal criterion outside that branch. A fixed-ratio filter and a certified interval L-value computation resolve further families and an explicit rigid triple. This revision completes the orbit analysis for the nine published rational order-four base triples, including five previously unresolved fixed bases. The proof retains the complete diagonal Kummer class and two additional necessary lift squares. Complete local tests at 29 or 37 handle four bases, including nonintegral parameters; rank-zero and real-collapse arguments handle four more. On the final base, a rank-one diagonal curve has eight explicitly generated Kummer classes, none equal to the required class. An independent rational-arithmetic replay verifies the local tables and class image. Two exact positive controls show why neither the old dyadic argument nor the diagonal quotient alone suffices: one nondegenerate nineteen-square orbit passes the real and 2-adic diagonal tests, and another base admits a rational diagonal-cover point that fails the remaining lifts. All-orbit conclusions are confined to the nine stated triples. The results do not exclude arbitrary irregular completions, unknown order-four bases, or rational septuples.

change_summary: Adds Theorem 9 and Section 9.1: all-orbit exclusion on the nine published order-four base triples, including five previously unresolved fixed cases. Uses the already published diagonal and lift identities, adding complete local certificates at 29/37 and a complete rank-one Kummer-image exclusion. Supplies an independent Fraction-based replay and two positive controls that distinguish the extra lift obstructions from the earlier quotient and dyadic theorem. Updates scope, abstract, references, artifact inventory and supplement manifest. Earlier mathematical results and their certificates are retained.

coauthors.contribution: Developed the order-four orbit construction and special real obstruction and infinite nonunit positive-rank exclusion, supplied the regular survivor and fixed-ratio investigations, and independently reproduced the dyadic identities, elementary classifications, rigorous L-value certificate and torsion computations; reviewed the product-one argument and combined manuscript. For version 2, independently derived the lift identities and duplication exception, audited completeness of the rank-one Kummer image, replayed all nine finite certificates, and checked the nineteen-square positive control.

title: Elliptic and dyadic obstructions to constrained Diophantine completion
